extracted.intended_audience: patent examiners, patent classifiers, patent attorneys and applicants preparing or searching patent classifications
extracted.subtask_description: A classification index of goods and apparatus (vehicle parts, electrical equipment, recording/communication devices, machines, etc.) intended to guide assignment of patent documents to appropriate classes and subclasses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vehicle parts and accessories (Class 12-16)
rubrics_metrics.description: Listings of vehicle components and accessories including brakes (FREINS DE VEHICULES), bumpers (PARE-CHOCS), radiators and radiator covers (RADIATEURS DE VEHICULES, COUVRE- RADIATEURS), luggage carriers (PORTE-BAGAGES), mud flaps (BAVETTES, MUD FLAPS), rearview mirrors and their fittings (RETROVISEURS, MIRRORS (REARVIEW -)), exhaust pipes (TUYAUX D'ECHAPPEMENT/EXHAUST PIPES), gear levers and change-speed levers, hubs, rims and wheel parts (WHEEL RIMS, HUBS, SPOKES), suspension parts and springs, steering wheels, sun visors, tow bars and towing attachments, wheel balancing weights, and many related vehicle fittings and ornaments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Generators and motors (Class 13 — 01)
rubrics_metrics.description: Equipment for generation/motion: dynamos (including for vehicles), generator sets, generators (ELECTRIC), electric motors, rotors of electric machines, stators of electric machines, and related components.

rubrics_metrics.name: Power transformers, rectifiers, batteries and accumulators (Class 13 — 021)
rubrics_metrics.description: Accumulators and batteries (accumulator jars, plates, dry batteries), apparatus for charging accumulators, battery plates, charging apparatus, coils (induction, ignition, self-induction), current rectifiers, voltage regulators, step-up and step-down transformers, voltage regulators and other transformer/rectifier/battery equipment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment for distribution or control of electric power (Class 13 — C31)
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribution/control apparatus: adapters for electrical connectors, sockets (including safety covers), binding posts, junction boxes, cable clips, electric cables (including submarine), circuit breakers (cut-outs), conduits and housings for conductors, plugs (including coaxial), switches and switchboards (commutation tables), relays (electric, telegraph/telephone), potentiometers, power points, regulators/stabilizers, fuse holders, insulators, terminals, conductors and related distribution and control hardware.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recording or reproduction of sounds or pictures (Class 11/recording equipment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Equipment for recording/reproducing sound or pictures: phonographs, record changers, record players/turntables, tape recorders (sound and video), sound recorders, talking machines, microphones for sound recording, needles (phonograph), loudspeakers, horns for loudspeakers, juke-boxes, audiovisual teaching aids, and related recording/playback apparatus.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment for recording/reproduction/retrieval of information (computing & data processing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Information-processing and retrieval equipment: computers, data processing equipment, document sorting machines (information retrieval), keyboards for card perforators, magnetic or perforated tapes and readers, perforators, punches for punched-card machines, readers/scanners for tapes and cards, tabulators and tabulating machines for punched cards, and related peripherals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications equipment and radio/TV apparatus (recording/communication class)
rubrics_metrics.description: Communications and radio/TV equipment: aerials/antennas (including for vehicles), receivers and radio sets (including transistor radios and vehicle radios), transmitters, detectors (hertzian wave detectors), dials, direction finders, headphones/earphones, microphones (telephone/monitoring), intercommunication systems, megaphones, emergency call boxes/telephones, exchanges (telephone), teleprinters, teletypes, television cameras and receivers, converters (frequency), repeaters, selectors and switchboards for telephony/telecommunications, walkie-talkie radios, and related apparatus.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic components and magnetic/recording media (Class 14-99)
rubrics_metrics.description: Electronic components and recording media: diodes (photo-transmission/photo-emissive), electronic tubes/vacuum tubes/radio tubes, radio tubes, photo-emissive diodes, magnetic tapes (including cassettes and cartridges), phonographic discs, and other related electronic components and storage media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Machines not elsewhere specified — Engines (non-electric) (Class 15 — 01)
rubrics_metrics.description: Non-electric engines and related parts: internal combustion engines, steam engines, hot-air engines, jet motors, engine pistons and cylinders, carburettors, exhaust silencers/mufflers, ignition regulators, spark plugs, fuel injection pumps, and rotors/stators of turbines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pumps and compressors (Class 15 — 021)
rubrics_metrics.description: Pumps and compressors: air pumps (including for inflating tyres and for condensers), laboratory air pumps, boiler feed pumps, central heating pumps, centrifugal pumps, direct-action pumps, suction and injection pumps for brine, vacuum pumps, compressors, grease guns (machines), pumps for mechanical lubricating equipment, and related pumping/compression machinery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agricultural machinery (Class 15 — 03)
rubrics_metrics.description: Agricultural machines and implements: chaffcutters, chaffcutting blades, cultivators (power driven), hay cutters, mowers, lawn mowers, seeders, sowing machines, ploughs and ploughshares, potato diggers, threshing machines, reaping and binding machines, manure spreaders, fertilizer spreaders, milking machines, baling machines, fodder presses, fumigators for plants, grain separators and related agricultural machinery and parts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Construction machinery (Class 15 — 04)
rubrics_metrics.description: Construction machines and equipment: asphalt paving machines, bulldozers, excavators and excavator buckets, dredgers and dredger buckets, concrete mixers (mixers for concrete, mortar), pile driver rams, road rollers (motor driven), drilling machines (construction), shovels (mechanical) and other civil engineering machinery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Washing, cleaning and drying machines (Class 15 — 05)
rubrics_metrics.description: Cleaning and drying machines: washing machines (laundry and for motor cars), dishwashers and dishwashing baskets/racks, bottle and barrel washing machines, vacuum cleaners (industrial and domestic, including carpet beaters and filling indicators), centrifugal drying machines, driers (hand and industrial), ironing machines and mangles, floor polishers, shoe-polishing machines, sewer cleaning machines, and related laundry/cleaning apparatus.

rubrics_metrics.name: Textile, sewing, knitting and embroidering machines (Class 15 — 06)
rubrics_metrics.description: Textile and sewing machinery: balling machines, battens for looms, bobbins (spinning), braiding machines, hemming machines, knitting looms and machines, hosiery looms, frames for embroidery (and perforators for frames), fabric stretching frames, gins (cotton), guides (shuttle), spinning quills/spindles, and related textile machinery and accessories.
